Why: The Lamplighter's install (AR7): its meshes and maps as published under the group on 2026-11-13 (docs/asset-log.md). Each glow says what it is (the attribute Glow): a spawn sets Body's and Mask's tint and strength as a Shade's (Config.Shades); the lantern's is the keeper's fall's to put out (Config.Effects.LamplighterFall). The lantern casts no shadow, being a light, and carries one: Lantern Row's cyan, which the fall dims with its glow, at the template's size (the spawn's ScaleTo scales its Range; the recipe leaves it to the builder). Collar, where the burst starts, is the builder's point, the Shade's own. Its name and health never show over it.
